entries.383cf1fe38e5d930: Companies supply ingredients to those who make food. This includes fats and oils for makers of bread, confectionery, and cafés, food raw materials such as sugar, wheat flour, and fats and oils, and feed used in livestock farming.

entries.3f2de6ece2e8811d: Companies handle meat such as pork, chicken, and beef, as well as chicken eggs and milk, starting from the stage of raising them. What is raised is sold to consumer cooperatives, mass retailers, retail stores, and others.
entries.4aa028755df81198: This is an industry that delivers food and drink through a flow of growing, making, wholesaling, and serving in stores. It includes companies that raise meat and eggs, companies that make seasonings, noodles, bread, beverages, and alcoholic drinks, companies that wholesale to supermarkets and other outlets, and companies that operate restaurants and convenience stores. Among the companies that make food, some extend their businesses beyond food, such as into pharmaceutical raw materials and health foods.
entries.56779e0f54875e25: Companies make and sell seasonings, instant noodles, bread, confectionery, ham and sausages, frozen foods, beverages, alcoholic drinks such as beer, and health foods. Some companies manufacture and sell not only in Japan but also overseas.
entries.585c7c587dd9da34: Some companies sell high-purity semiconductor materials and similar products to companies involved in semiconductor manufacturing.
entries.6300f35ff674db2b: Companies purchase processed foods, alcoholic drinks, and foods requiring refrigeration or freezing, and wholesale them to customers such as supermarkets and drugstores. There are also transactions for the restaurant industry and wholesaling to customers overseas.
